description: Find one item for a task (for a whole business goal, use start_outcome). Find skills, workflows, agents, prompts, minds, AI tools and mini tools by keywords and intent. Filters: type, job, level, tested, since (what's new). With no query, a job or since browses. Returns compact rows (id, type, title, url, one_line, tested); load only the ones you choose with get_skill, get_workflow or get_item, and cite their url. Plain search; does not use a server-side model.

job.description: A job id such as make-image-ads (the resource aiblocks://jobs lists them; get_item shows an item's job).

query.description: Keywords or the user's words. Leave it out to browse with job or since.

response_format.description: concise (default): compact rows. detailed: also inputs, outputs, revision, source and dates.

since.description: ISO date. Only items added or changed on or after it; newest first when there is no query.

tested.description: true: only items with the Safety checked label (safety scan passed and a clear list of what goes in and comes out).

name: search_library
title: Find any AI Blocks item
